stem:
Snacks at a county fair are sold in containers shaped like a cone or a cylinder. The dimensions of each container are shown in the drawing.

Which statement about the volumes of the cone and the cylinder is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The volume of the cylinder is about 377 cubic inches greater than the volume of the cone.

options.label: B
options.text: The volume of the cylinder is about 377 cubic inches less than the volume of the cone.

options.label: C
options.text: The volume of the cylinder is about 25 cubic inches greater than the volume of the cone.

options.label: D
options.text: The volume of the cylinder is about 25 cubic inches less than the volume of the cone.

visual_elements: Cone with radius 4 in and height 12 in
Cylinder with radius 3 in and height 8 in
